_original_lore: Sadan is the boss of Floor 6 of the Catacombs.
He is a 'Necromancer Lord' and has three phases.
In the first he summons a teracotta army that must
be survied for 100 seconds. After that he summons four
giants and once killed, he merges them into himself.
name: 萨丹 (首领)

source: Sadan is the boss of Floor {{N0}} of the Catacombs.
loreParagraphs.translation: 萨丹 是地牢第 {{N0}} 层的首领.

source: He is a 'Necromancer Lord' and has three phases.
loreParagraphs.translation: 他是一位“死灵法师领主”,共有三个阶段.

source: In the first he summons a teracotta army that must
be survied for {{N0}} seconds. After that he summons four
giants and once killed, he merges them into himself.
loreParagraphs.translation: 第一阶段他会召唤一支陶土军队,必须存活 {{N0}} 秒.之后他会召唤四个巨人,击杀后将其融入自身.
